purpose: Request decision-ready external architecture review on a shared structure rather than free-form commentary.

questions.title: Current-state diagnosis
questions.prompt: What is the simplest accurate architecture description of the system today, including runtime spine, legacy mesh, and main authority seams?

questions.title: Semantic ownership assessment
questions.prompt: Is the single semantic owner direction viable as the governing architecture, and what exact constraints are needed so deterministic layers do not become a second owner?
expected_answer_shape: failure modes if constraints are ignored

questions.title: Fact-side architecture
questions.prompt: What fact-side architecture object is missing today, and what should replace the current mixed fact selection/composition/rendering behavior?

questions.title: State and truth carriers
questions.prompt: How should semantic state, pending-question continuity, and projections be normalized so multiple truth carriers stop fighting each other?

questions.title: Boundary and degrade authority
questions.prompt: What should the deterministic boundary be allowed to do, and what should it be forbidden from doing?

questions.title: Module salvage and deletion
questions.prompt: Which live modules are salvageable, adapter-only, or delete candidates, and in what order should they be treated?

questions.title: Migration program critique
questions.prompt: Is the current migration order realistic, and what should be reordered, split, or added?

questions.title: Quality governance
questions.prompt: What additional governance, acceptance, or evidence rules are needed so future work does not regress into patch-loop behavior?

questions.title: Unknowns and research gaps
questions.prompt: What important unknowns remain even after reading this packet, and what repo/runtime evidence would reduce them?

questions.title: First implementation slice recommendation
questions.prompt: Assuming no rewrite fantasy, what should the first architecture-recovery implementation slice be, and what must it prove?
